_meta.purpose: Single source of truth for which product videos have already been MADE + scheduled. The Social Content Tool checks every suggestion (occasion match, random filler day, and the manual SKU box) against this list and skips anything here, so a product video is never repeated. Keyed by SKU (the code on each Tab 1 card, e.g. BEDJPN3).
_meta.how_it_updates: When a Tab 1 card is marked complete (turns grey), the tool appends its SKU here and saves to GitHub. Nothing is stored locally.
_meta.seed_note: Seeded 2026-07-09 with the 26 videos already created and scheduled in Metricool (the original launch run). Owner to confirm/add any other greyed-out cards not in this list.
